title: SMP Core
description: all-in-one utility plugin for SMP servers
body:
🔥 Essential SMP Core Plugin

A powerful all-in-one plugin designed for SMP servers, combining combat logging prevention, command control, teleportation, and chat management into a single lightweight solution.

---

✨ Features

⚔️ Combat System

* Enter combat for 30 minutes when attacking or being attacked
* Triggers include:

  * Melee attacks
  * Player projectiles (arrows, tridents, potions, etc.)
  * Player-ignited TNT
  * End crystals and TNT minecarts (proper damage source tracking)
* Non-combat damage (fall, fire, drowning, etc.) does NOT trigger combat
* Both players exit combat on death
* Logging out during combat results in instant death
* `/pvpcancel` — request to cancel combat (requires both players to accept)
* `/pvpdeny` — deny combat cancel request

🛑 Command Control

* No restrictions outside combat
* During combat:

  * All commands require a 15-second warmup
  * Warmup is canceled if valid combat damage is taken
* Implemented globally for all commands

📡 Teleport Requests (TPA)

* `/tpa <player>` — send teleport request (expires in 60 seconds)
* `/tpaccept` — accept and teleport instantly
* `/tpdeny` — deny request

🏠 Home System

* `/sethome <name>` — set a home (max 3)
* `/home <name>` — teleport or view home list
* `/delhome <name>` — delete a home
* Works with combat warmup
* Data is saved per-player (UUID) and persists after restart

↩️ Utility Commands

* `/back` — return to last death location within 1 minute
* `/logout` — safe logout (15s warmup in combat, instant otherwise)

💬 Chat Control

* Chat disabled during combat
* 2-second chat cooldown (first message after join is exempt)
* Prevents duplicate messages
* Blocks configurable messages from `config.yml` (case-insensitive)

---

💡 Why this plugin?

* All-in-one SMP solution (no need for multiple plugins)
* Designed specifically for survival multiplayer servers
* Lightweight and optimized
* Fair combat system (no abuse, no unfair escapes)
* Simple but powerful configuration

---

📦 Installation

1. Download the plugin
2. Place it in your `/plugins` folder
3. Restart your server

---

🎯 Recommended For

* SMP / Survival servers
* Small to medium communities
* Server owners who want a clean, balanced gameplay experience
